<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/projects/{projectId}/container/lifecycle"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



`null` when the project was never provisioned — the common case today, because no real orchestrator transitions this table yet (RN-243/RN-267). `status`/`imageVersion`/`resources` are what was RECORDED; `observado` is what the Docker daemon reports right now, asked through the broker (ADR 0130). The two are never fused: a container killed from the outside reads as recorded `running` and observed `exited`. When there was no way to look, `observado` is `null` and `naoObservado` says why — it never inherits the recorded state (RN-468).
